transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to get our pre-lock round-robin started so we can move toward final production approval on the gala broadcast package. We've got the three-camera setup, the festival archive reuse, the sponsor product display on stage, and a general caption feed in the current draft. Before I can sign off, I need each of your final operating requirements on the record. Let's start with technical, then rights, talent, and accessibility. Who's ready to go first?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to get my RF survey findings on the record. My completed radio-frequency survey found that wireless roaming camera links interfere with the Orpheum Theater's assistive-listening loop. Because of that, the gala must use three fixed wired cameras operating from the marked camera platforms — no wireless roaming cameras. I filed the survey in the technical folder, but it's not on Mara's draft lock sheet yet, so I want to make sure it's captured here in the round-robin before final approval.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to get my rights findings on the record before we proceed. My signed performance license — which I received countersigned this morning and haven't yet entered in the rights tracker — permits the gala broadcast, but it explicitly prohibits any video-on-demand release or later promotional clips. The recording must be marked broadcast-only. This directly conflicts with the current draft package's provision permitting the recording to be reused in the festival archive, since that would constitute a use beyond the broadcast. We need to either remove the festival archive reuse from the package or secure a separate license amendment before I can sign off.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to get my talent findings on the record before we proceed. I confirmed with the headliner's agent that the performer can soundcheck only at exactly 3:00 PM on Saturday, and the rider explicitly prohibits sponsor product placement anywhere on the performance stage. I have the agent's confirmation in email, but it is not in the production schedule. The soundcheck time constraint needs to be reflected in the schedule, and the sponsor product display on stage directly conflicts with the rider prohibition — we need to either remove the sponsor product display from the stage or secure a rider amendment before I can sign off.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to get my accessibility findings on the record before we proceed. My accessibility vendor confirmed that the live caption feed requires the captioner to work from Booth B, whose dedicated return feed is connected to the gala's caption encoder. The general plan's control-room location will not work for the caption feed. I documented the vendor confirmation in the accessibility file, but I have not yet added the booth assignment to the lock sheet, so I want to make sure it's captured here in the round-robin before final approval. The Booth B assignment needs to be reflected on the lock sheet.
transcript.speaker: A5
